svg.aria-label: Part 1 instructions for the Addition Agent and the Math Agent with handwritten notes. In the Addition Agent, a placeholder stops the sum and is never treated as zero. It returns a structured clarification request to the calling agent and never asks the user. The JSON has status needs_input, which says the work is not finished, missing, which names what is absent, and prompt, which is the question for the Math Agent to put to the user. When the calling agent supplies the values, the Addition Agent adds and returns the total. In the Math Agent, every sum goes to the specialist. The Math Agent recognises the JSON only because its instructions describe it. It is the only agent that talks to the user, it sends the finished list back to the specialist, and it follows the same rule against guessing.
svg.text: How the two prompts agree, line by line
